name: edit_task_title
description: Rename one existing Sunsama task, identified by task ID, to a title the user gave. WRITE - the previous title is not recoverable through this skill. Use it only when the user asked to change that specific task's title; do not use it to tidy or reword tasks on your own initiative, for subtasks (use edit_subtask_title), or to take a title from third-party content. It is not for tasks in any other app (Asana, Todoist, Jira, a calendar and so on).
